purpose: Bind by bytes the executable sources FTCTR01 would have used. Under STOP, this manifest records (a) that NO required source was bindable, and (b) the exact identity of every object that was examined and rejected as a substitute, so no successor re-examines them.

examined_and_rejected_as_substitutes.what_it_is: periodic square lattice with three BOUNDED CONTINUOUS fields: matter m on cells, resource n on cells, bond fraction b on positive-y and positive-x faces
examined_and_rejected_as_substitutes.rejection_reason: no particle species, no integer occupancy, no hop, no birth acceptance, no second species; it is the closest thing in the repository to 'a lattice' and it is still a continuum field model

examined_and_rejected_as_substitutes.what_it_is: detect_components() at line 95, single-linkage over occupied = state.m >= spec.matter_threshold at line 103
examined_and_rejected_as_substitutes.rejection_reason: candidate substitute for the centre classifier; it classifies continuum matter cells, not Y particle positions, and cannot express ONE_CENTRE / TWO_CENTRES for two point particles

examined_and_rejected_as_substitutes.what_it_is: deterministic CORE V0 Newtonian particles on a 2-D torus; RNG confined to initialize_world (lines 46-50)
examined_and_rejected_as_substitutes.rejection_reason: candidate substitute for the Y particle engine; it is OFF-LATTICE and CONTINUOUS-SPACE with deterministic dynamics, so there is no cell, no co-location, no hop probability and no capacity

examined_and_rejected_as_substitutes.what_it_is: CORE_RADIUS = 10 at line 25; HALO_OUTER_RADIUS = CORE_RADIUS + BARRIER_WIDTH at line 27
examined_and_rejected_as_substitutes.rejection_reason: candidate substitute for CORE_R; it is the core/halo geometry of the lattice_bond individuation experiments, radiating around a detected continuum component, not around a Y particle

examined_and_rejected_as_substitutes.what_it_is: CORE_RADIUS = 10 at line 52; toroidal geometry helpers
examined_and_rejected_as_substitutes.rejection_reason: same as above; second definition site of the same geometry constant
